subject: succulent armchair creature
art_direction: 一团多肉叶像深坐扶手椅的圆角色，两片叶托脸，青绿叶缘配桃色底。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Turn a compact succulent rosette into a lounging character, with thick leaves arranged like a soft armchair around a small round central face. Two curled leaves support its chin, while lower leaves form broad feet. Give it a half-amused contented expression, keeping the face minimal and integrated with the plant. Use chalk pastel in sage and dusty teal against a warm peach field, with no pot or furniture beneath it. Let soft powder texture sit within large shapes, avoiding glossy leaves, realistic plant hairs, or extra props. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
